Strategic Wealth Advisors Groupinc Holding in Microsoft (MSFT) Has Cut as Valuation Rose; As Sprott Focus Tr (FUND) Market Value Declined, Shaker Financial Services Has Raised by $1.10 Million Its Position
May 18, 2018 - By Linda Rogers
Shaker Financial Services Llc increased its stake in Sprott Focus Tr Inc (FUND) by 50.64% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Shaker Financial Services Llc bought 157,001 shares as the company’s stock declined 0.38% with the market. The institutional investor held 467,030 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $3.70M, up from 310,029 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Shaker Financial Services Llc who had been investing in Sprott Focus Tr Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $191.53M market cap company. The stock decreased 0.13% or $0.01 during the last trading session, reaching $7.98. About 301 shares traded. Sprott Focus Trust, Inc. – Clos (NASDAQ:FUND) has risen 7.41% since May 18, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 4.14% the S&P500.
Strategic Wealth Advisors Groupinc decreased its stake in Microsoft Corp (MSFT) by 26.83% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Strategic Wealth Advisors Groupinc sold 48,084 shares as the company’s stock rose 4.63% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 131,114 shares of the prepackaged software company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $11.22 million, down from 179,198 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Strategic Wealth Advisors Groupinc who had been investing in Microsoft Corp for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $742.20 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.44% or $0.42 during the last trading session, reaching $96.6. About 4.32M shares traded. Microsoft Corporation (NASDAQ:MSFT) has risen 37.43% since May 18, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 25.88% the S&P500.
Shaker Financial Services Llc, which manages about $132.85M and $211.53M US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Central Secs Corp (NYSEMKT:CET) by 55,459 shares to 319,279 shares, valued at $8.75 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Apollo Tactical Income Fd In (AIF) by 32,251 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 141,557 shares, and cut its stake in Eaton Vance Risk Mngd Div Eq (ETJ).
More notable recent Microsoft Corporation (NASDAQ:MSFT) news were published by: 247Wallst.com which released: “How Microsoft Went From Acquirer to Partner” on April 19, 2018, also Investorplace.com with their article: “3 Stocks to Watch on Thursday: Booking Holdings Inc (BKNG), Microsoft Corporation (MSFT) and Qualcomm, Inc …” published on May 10, 2018, 247Wallst.com published: “Microsoft Catches Amazon as Second Most Valuable Company” on April 25, 2018. More interesting news about Microsoft Corporation (NASDAQ:MSFT) were released by: Benzinga.com and their article: “Microsoft Presents New Technology At Build Conference” published on May 08, 2018 as well as Seekingalpha.com ‘s news article titled: “Microsoft Does It Again” with publication date: May 01, 2018.
Analysts await Microsoft Corporation (NASDAQ:MSFT) to report earnings on July, 19. They expect $1.08 EPS, up 10.20% or $0.10 from last year’s $0.98 per share. MSFT’s profit will be $8.30 billion for 22.36 P/E if the $1.08 EPS becomes a reality. After $0.95 actual EPS reported by Microsoft Corporation for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts 13.68% EPS growth.
Since February 16, 2018, it had 0 insider buys, and 3 selling transactions for $930,912 activity.
Strategic Wealth Advisors Groupinc, which manages about $955.83 million US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 179,432 shares to 238,336 shares, valued at $40.33 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Ford Mtr Co Del (NYSE:F) by 51,878 shares in the quarter, for a total of 70,661 shares, and has risen its stake in Ishares Tr (IEMG).
Among 37 analysts covering Microsoft Corporation ( NASDAQ:MSFT ), 31 have Buy rating, 1 Sell and 5 Hold. Therefore 84% are positive. Microsoft Corporation had 183 analyst reports since July 22, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. As per Wednesday, September 13, the company rating was maintained by Canaccord Genuity. Credit Suisse maintained the stock with “Buy” rating in Tuesday, August 22 report. The firm earned “Hold” rating on Friday, August 21 by Vetr. The firm earned “Outperform” rating on Friday, January 8 by BMO Capital Markets. Wunderlich maintained the shares of MSFT in report on Friday, January 29 with “Hold” rating. The stock has “Buy” rating by RBC Capital Markets on Thursday, February 1. The stock of Microsoft Corporation (NASDAQ:MSFT) has “Overweight” rating given on Friday, October 23 by Barclays Capital. The stock of Microsoft Corporation (NASDAQ:MSFT) earned “Buy” rating by Barclays Capital on Friday, January 12. Linda Rogers
